changes.detail: The first release: insight_events, insight_actors and insight_daily_actives as Drizzle tables, and createInsights over them: markActive (exact daily activity, at most one write per person per day), track (server or browser events, names lowercase-dotted, browser clocks clamped), identify (label and signup time), activeSeries (daily, rolling 7- and 30-day and new people), retention (weekly cohorts), funnel (ordered steps with median time between), featureUsage (people, events and the period before), people, person (with active days and a timeline), purgeEventsBefore and forget; plus createBrowserTracker from ./browser, a consent-gated batching tracker.
changes.summary: Insights: active people, retention cohorts, activation funnels, feature usage and a per-person timeline, from server and consented browser events
